empty_space.where: The bottom-left column under the 'Problem & Motivation' section is completely empty, leaving 25% of the canvas unused and unbalancing the layout.
empty_space.effect: It makes the poster look unfinished and wastes valuable space that could have been used to expand on the methodology or results.

small_visual_text.where: In Figure 2 (bottom middle) and Figure 7 (middle right), the axis labels, legends, and tick marks are extremely small.
small_visual_text.effect: A viewer standing 1–2 meters away would not be able to read the specific values, units, or legend categories in these crucial plots.

layout.reason: The bottom-left column is left completely blank, leaving 25% of the canvas unused and creating a highly unbalanced visual flow.

readability.reason: While the main body text is legible, the text within the figures (specifically the axes and legends of Figures 2 and 7) is far too small to be read at a normal viewing distance.

fidelity.reason: The poster accurately and comprehensively presents the ALBIREO framework, its key components, and its evaluation results on the BDD100K dataset.

holistic.reason: Although the poster is scientifically faithful and well-structured, it has major visual weaknesses, including a completely empty bottom-left column (25% unused canvas) and illegibly small text in the key evaluation figures.
